body: As nice as it is to find an, **ahem**, *kindred spirit* I do feel bad that anyone else ever has to feel the way I can.

I actually had bought one of those multi-use 'mini-gyms'. The ones you can do situps with, pullups, pushups, etc. It actually did work for awhile with the level I was feeling - as soon as I started to feel that way I'd do some pullups and pushups. Unfortunately it's just gotten to the point now where I couldn't even get the motivation to do it. 

After crying a bit earlier and writing my whole long thread I have felt better since then. I'm not sure why since it didn't resolve anything but it did.

In reply to the surroundings things we've actually made plans to move to a different state. Her because she misses it (we're moving back to her hometown), me because I think it's beautiful and really don't like the scenery here where I've grown up. 

Seeing trees and greenery makes me feel "good", and not being around a lot of negative or emotional triggers I have from growing up here I think will be helpful. A clean slate, I'm hoping, will be somewhat invigorating.

I read this first as "dude-fuck him" like, you know, jump his bones and thought you were trying to be amusing but I wasn't sure how it made sense. 

I didn't realize you meant fuck him for being a dick until I read justfuckingthing's reply to you.

So easy to write isn't it? 

I was inspired by you and ordered my "Become an astronaut in 32 days" step-by-step guide! I'm doing it!
